title: Queue excluded source path compaction
summary: Shorten the WebView Queue backend-excluded Source column display while preserving the full source path for hover inspection.
reason: Long UNC source paths wrap across many lines in the backend-excluded source files table, reducing the number of visible rows.
behavior_before: The Queue backend-excluded source rows table rendered the full source_path string directly in the Source cell, causing long UNC paths to wrap into tall rows.
behavior_after: The Source cell renders a compact path with root, parent folder, and filename context, applies the standard path-cell ellipsis styling, and keeps the full path in the cell title.
